node.title: W3 two-class minimal-ledger reduction
node.statement: For a planted-sunflower receiver U, the exact list is the disjoint union of its distinct printed planted polynomials P(U) and every non-planted list polynomial. Hence |List(U)|=p(U)+N_nonplant(U), and safety is equivalent to N_nonplant(U)<=B*-p(U) when p(U)<=B*; p(U)>B* is immediately unsafe. Structural paid subcolumns are optional proof refinements, not W3 interface prerequisites.
